_comment: AER-679 moving-position pass threshold. 50 ms is PROBE_GAP_WARN_MS from src/pyefis/instruments/map/perf.py -- the project's existing GUI-thread-stall gate (MP6), reused here so the map and SVS share one canonical frame-gap number. Cross-checked against AER-677's own measurement: healthy SVS gap ~25 ms (40 fps) vs the reproduced defect's ~699 ms (1.4 fps); 50 ms sits with clean margin above healthy and two orders of magnitude below the defect. See docs/moving_map_spec.md section 9.2.
